experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: fj -> fcc chain; the loop is closed through movcf2gr and movgr2fr, and that closure costs the same for both entries.

latencies.notes: Latency to FCC is 1 cycle. The chain closure through movcf2gr (3 cycles) and movgr2fr (1 cycle) is subtracted; the residual 0.08 is calibration noise. Raw measurement was 1.04; the residual is a systematic +0.03..0.1 calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread. Raw slope-method measurement was 1.00; the value is 1 cycle(s) and any earlier range was a rounding artifact.

throughput.notes: 8 independent comparisons take 3.98 cycles. The measured CPI 0.4975 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: Both floating-point sources reach the FCC result in 1 cycle. The recorded chain values include the constant movcf2gr/movgr2fr closure.
